review.method: Visual review with local Whisper transcript support

steps.title: Play and type
steps.instruction: Play the video and type each spoken line in the subtitle field.

steps.title: Start each new line
steps.instruction: Press Enter when the speaker starts a new subtitle line.

steps.title: Use automatic pause
steps.instruction: Select automatic pause and use Tab to control playback when necessary.

steps.title: Complete the typing step
steps.instruction: Type the remaining lines and select Done when the video ends.
